activities.related_external_id.reason: WhatId holds the related Account or Opportunity Id.

activities.related_type.reason: WhatId points to Account (001) or Opportunity (006); prefix lookup tested 50/50.

activities.subject.reason: Direct match, but Subject is optional in Salesforce and the target requires it; all sampled values were populated.

contacts.account_external_id.reason: Reference to Account Id, which is accounts.external_id.

contacts.email.question_for_admin: Some contacts have no Email, which the target requires. Should those be skipped, held for fixing, or given a placeholder?
contacts.email.reason: Email field matches, but target requires it and 2 of 50 sampled contacts have null Email.

contacts.phone.question_for_admin: A few phones are 7 digits with no area code (e.g. 999-9999). Should these be dropped (phone is optional) or fixed another way? Is US (+1) the right default for numbers without a country code?
contacts.phone.reason: Mixed formats (dashes, dots, parentheses, +country). normalize_phone with default country 1 works on 48/50; 2 values are 7-digit local numbers with no area code and can't be repaired.

contacts.role.reason: Contact has only Title and Department (job title/function), not buying-role. The target note says role is not job title, so I did not map from Title. Left unmapped (optional).

deals.amount.question_for_admin: Some opportunities have no Amount, which the target requires. Should they be skipped, or loaded with 0?
deals.amount.reason: Currency field matches, but target requires it and 3 of 50 sampled opportunities have null Amount.

deals.currency.reason: No CurrencyIsoCode field is readable, so the org looks single-currency. Using the target default USD.

deals.owner_email.reason: No owner field readable on Opportunity. Left unmapped (optional).

deals.stage.reason: All six picklist values map one-to-one to the target enum; tested 50/50.
